chapters.title: Preparing with labels and info types

takeaways: Copilot does not create new security problems; it exposes existing oversharing, outdated data and weak permissions.
Start with sensitive information types, sensitivity labels, DLP and conditional access, which are available even with E3 licenses, before rolling out Copilot broadly.
Copilot readiness is really Microsoft 365 data governance readiness and needs management ownership, clear use cases and cleanup of old Teams and sharing links.
hook: Is your tenant really ready for Copilot, or will AI surface everything you overshared during the pandemic? Microsoft MVP and MCT Åsne Holtklimpen explains why Copilot readiness is a data governance problem and how Purview, sensitivity labels and zero trust fit together. IT, security and business leaders get practical first steps to secure their data before switching AI on.
